note: Open-sea companions for the chosen Whitby paintings, to complete the 360-degree sky. Claude, 25 Nov 2026.
style: One single wide oil painting filling the whole frame edge to edge. No town, no abbey, no lighthouse, no ships, no boats, no people; no text, lettering, signature, monogram, border or black bars.

beats.text: Open sea under a deep cobalt sky with towering golden cumulus clouds heaped along the horizon, warm late-afternoon light from the right, a calm deep-blue sea with gentle swell, in the manner of Maxfield Parrish. This picture is the section of one wide panorama that lies immediately to the LEFT of the reference painting, seen from the same spot far out at sea. At the far right edge the coastline continues where the reference painting begins: low, dark, distant cliffs and shore, small on the horizon, running in from the right edge for about a fifth of the width and then ending, so the rest of the picture is open sea and sky. The horizon is at exactly the same height as in the reference, about two-thirds of the way down, perfectly level.

Open sea at night in a storm under heavy dark clouds, moonlight breaking through in places, the faint edge of a lighthouse beam reaching in from the right, rough grey-green sea with breaking waves and spray, in the manner of J.
